title: What If Every Fish on Earth Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every fish vanished? The biggest shock wouldn't be in the sea. It'd be on your plate.
Fish supply about seventeen percent of all the animal protein people eat around the world.
For about three point two billion people, that's nearly twenty percent of their animal protein.
Nearly sixty million people work directly in fishing and fish farming. Those jobs would vanish with the catch.
In 2016 alone, people pulled about ninety-one million tonnes of fish from the wild.
Every one of those meals would have to come from land instead. The sea would go quiet, but our table would feel it first.

description:
What if every fish on Earth vanished overnight?
Fish supply about 17 percent of the world's animal protein, and nearly 60 million people work in fishing and fish farming.
What should we run through next?
